questions.stem_text:

nucleus in MeV.

Calculate the self-inductance of a coil if a rate of change of current of 5 amperes per
second produces a backemfof 2 volts.

What happens to the force of gravitational attraction between two small objects if the
mass of each object is doubled and the distance between their centers is doubled?

options.A: It is increased by two times.
options.E: It is increased by eight times.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - It remains the same.

questions.stem_text:
What is the focal length, of a combination of two thin convex lenses, each of focal length
f, placed apart at a distance of (2 f / 3)?
Why are the season's in Mars' southern hemisphere so extreme?

options.A: because Mars' axis is less tilted than the Earth's
options.B: because Mars has a smaller size than the Earth
options.C: because Mars has a slower rotation speed than the Earth
options.D: because Mars has more carbon dioxide in its atmosphere than the Earth
options.E: because Mars has a shorter year than the Earth

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - because Mars' axis is less tilted than the Earth's
